d: The Forum of Civil Pensioners Associations has submitted an 11-point memorandum to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, seeking major changes to pension rules and retirement benefits under the 8th Pay Commission. Its demands include equal pension benefits for employees who retired before January 1, 2026, restoration of the Old Pension Scheme, merger of 50% DA and DR with basic pay and pension, and at least 20% interim relief.
